note: RECORDED BUG SHAPE — 2026-08-24. news-feed.json is append-only and written by two merging writers, so the same id can arrive twice with different collectedAt. The workflow's replay path unions by id and a hand-resolved conflict does too, but git's TEXTUAL auto-merge does neither: different collectedAt means different lines, so a clean merge keeps both. This META item was collected 08-19 and re-collected 08-24 and survived a merge that reported no conflict. Must FAIL.
